title: Electricity from natural gas (FI) labelled MJ but modelled per kWh
datasets: 401085 Electricity, natural gas, at power plant (FI)
observation: Reference unit MJ; its 29 sibling regions and its only consumer (`Electricity, from natural gas`, FI, 0.0156738 kWh) use kWh. The dataset is modelled per kWh (14.07 MJ gas per unit against a sibling median of 7.17 MJ/kWh; 3.6 / 14.07 = its stated 25.6 % efficiency): a label error, no rescale. BAFU's own `LCIA-Results.xlsx` applies ×3.6 on that edge, overstating FI gas electricity by about 9 % and the FI production mix by about 2 %. The same error affects 316743 `Electricity, hard coal, at power plant, merged` (IN, labelled MJ, about 0.76 kg coal per unit, no consumer).
validation_scope: Re-measured on the release files on 2026-10-21; the dataset is modelled per kWh. BAFU's published LCIA-Results.xlsx reproduces to six digits with the edge multiplied by 3.6 (sentier-brightway backtest, 2026-10-21). 316743 (IN coal, no consumer) has the same label error.
next_action: Send to BAFU with the next batch: relabel the reference unit of 401085 and 316743 as kWh, no rescale; note that the published scores of FI gas electricity and the FI mix are overstated by about 9 % and 2 %.
